method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Time to crack as you type
features.detail: "It would take a computer about ... to crack your password"

features.name: Strength checks list
features.detail: length, character variety, common password, dictionary word warnings

features.name: Password never sent
features.verse_evidence: footer: never sent, stored or put in the address

features.name: Leak / breach check
features.detail: whether the password has appeared in a breach (offered elsewhere on Security.org)
features.verse_evidence: "Has it leaked?" k-anonymity to Have I Been Pwned

features.name: Password generator link
features.verse_evidence: /password/ hands passwords over in the fragment

features.name: Adjustable guesses per second
features.detail: the original hsimp let you set the cracker speed
features.verse_evidence: two fixed speeds: 10 billion/s offline, 100/s at a login
